summary: Update documentation to match verified behavior and the reader’s task.

inputs.name: change-set
inputs.description: Candidate behavior, changed surfaces, and verification evidence.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Intended behavior, scope, and accepted terminology.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Documentation locations, audiences, conventions, and existing operational guidance.

completion_checks: Changed behavior is reflected in the relevant documentation surfaces.
Instructions, examples, links, and claims are checked within the available environment.
Documentation types and audience needs remain distinct.
failure_modes: Required example execution or source verification is unavailable: blocked.
Documentation contradicts observed or specified behavior: failed.
Material claims cannot be verified: inconclusive.
